metadata.dataset_name: AWS Tulas Website MCP Test Dataset
metadata.data_policy: Official website facts are marked official; expanded examples are synthetic test data.
metadata.important_note: This dataset is for MCP development and testing. Do not treat synthetic event dates, contacts, prices, people, metrics, or commitments as official.

company.name: AWS Student Builder Group
company.description: A student-led technical community at Tulas University, Dehradun, focused on practical cloud learning, building real-world applications, collaboration, hackathons, and career growth.

community.membership_note: The homepage states that 50+ students have already joined. Other live counters currently display zero and should not be interpreted as verified membership totals.

company.mission: Make cloud computing accessible, practical, and exciting through hands-on learning and collaborative building.
company.vision: Help students turn curiosity into deployed projects, stronger portfolios, and technology careers.

pillars.name: Cloud Learning
pillars.description: Hands-on workshops using AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway, Amplify, and Bedrock.

pillars.name: Build Projects
pillars.description: Encourage members to deploy working cloud applications rather than only watching tutorials.

pillars.name: Community
pillars.description: Peer learning, mentorship, code reviews, study groups, and collaborative building.

pillars.name: Hackathons
pillars.description: AWS GameDays, hackathons, build sprints, and innovation challenges.

pillars.name: Certifications
pillars.description: Preparation sessions, study plans, practice exams, and AWS Skill Builder resources.

pillars.name: Career Growth
pillars.description: Networking with AWS professionals, industry mentors, alumni, and student builders.

builder_journey.title: Join SBG

builder_journey.title: AWS Fundamentals
builder_journey.description: Learn core services, IAM, and cloud concepts.
